en.titre:
5 RULES EVERY
MAN SHOULD
LIVE BY.

en.texte: Write down your 3 priorities before bed. You wake up with a plan instead of a phone in your hand.
The first hour sets your mood. Leave your phone alone until you've moved and eaten.
Discipline is running on busy weeks too. A running coach app like Atala adjusts your plan when your week gets packed.
Train strength 2 to 3 times a week. A strong body changes how you carry yourself.
Being late tells people their time matters less. Show up 5 minutes early, every time.
